title: SWF: DefineSpriteSymbol for MovieClip library items
description: Library Symbol items with symbolType='movieclip' should be encoded as DefineSprite (tag 39) in the SWF. Check packages/swf/src/compile.ts — search for 'DefineSprite', 'symbol', 'movieclip'. If not yet implemented: encode each Symbol's timeline as a nested DefineSprite (charId assigned from charIdMap, then the symbol's layers/frames encode their own displaylist inside). The top-level scene then places the sprite via PlaceObject2. This is a major feature — if already implemented, add unit tests verifying DefineSprite is emitted for symbols.
